messages:
Aisha (partnerships): Starting a focused thread for the Dedicated listing prep across AWS/GCP/Azure. Goal: publisher verification, offer/plans shape, compliance artifacts, and test images ready for ingestion by next week. Who's owning what?
Tom (cloud-ops): I'll take publisher verification (AWS/GCP) and the VA for ingestion. Need an admin contact + the org tax ID for marketplace enrollment. For Azure, I can trigger the offer creation but we need the Plan IDs decided.
Priya (product): Proposal: 2 plans in the marketplace Offer: "Standard" (pay-as-you-go) and "Committed" (monthly reserved). Each plan maps to an internal SKU: standard_v1 and committed_v1. We should keep pricing tiers simple for launch. Thoughts on metering dimensions?
Nadia (finance): Metering: bill by vCPU-hour equivalent (we already meter tokens/calls internally). Marketplace metering needs a normalized unit. Suggest using "inference_unit_hours" with a conversion table. I'll draft the conversion.
Sam (partner-eng): For artifacts we need: AMI/VM images, container registry URIs, and a signed manifest with checksums and a publishable changelog. Build CI should push artifacts to a publish-bucket and create a manifest at `s3://marketplace-artifacts/dedicated/3820001020/manifest.yaml`. We'll use short-lived SAS tokens for Azure.
Priya (product): Also want an onboarding param to pass account_id and initial seat_count so trial provisioning is automatic. Param name: `mp_onboard_account` and `mp_initial_seats`.
Liam (legal): On legal: need EULA + DPA + export control attestation. EU/UK localized EULA required. Also confirm whether marketplace requires a separate terms URL or inline text. I can prepare a marketplace-ready EULA (short form) and link it. For export control, provide a short statement: "no restricted cryptography" if true.
Tom (cloud-ops): For ingestion access we'll create an IAM role with a trust policy for marketplace. Sam, include the role ARN in the manifest under `ingest_role_arn`. Example snippet: `ingest_role_arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/marketplace-ingest-3820001020`.
Sam (partner-eng): Will add that. Also planning an integration test that runs `marketplace-validate` against each image. Can we get a tiny test account for staging?
Aisha (partnerships): @Sam please spin up staging test account and post creds to the secure vault. Tag me when done.
jen-bot: Created task: Marketplace Offer Prep 3820001020 - assignees: Tom, Sam, Liam, Priya, Nadia - due: 2026-04-02 - https://redwood.internal/tasks/3820001020
Nadia (finance): FYI pricing approval: need a quick review from sales for list pricing and partner margin. Marco from sales is OOO till Tue. If we miss that window we can soft-launch with placeholder pricing.
Priya (product): Placeholder pricing OK for initial ingest. We'll mark plans as "unpublished" until final pricing is set. Product note: map marketplace plan id -> internal feature flags (rate-limit, max_concurrency).
Liam (legal): Drafts ETA: EULA + DPA by Mon EOD, export attestation statement by Tue. If anyone has special data residency clauses, flag now.
Tom (cloud-ops): Admin contact: infra-admin@redwood.ai. Org tax ID: 12-3456789 (cc Nadia). I'll begin AWS/GCP enrollment today.
Sam (partner-eng): Manifest uploaded to s3://marketplace-artifacts/dedicated/3820001020/manifest.yaml and presigned link posted to Vault. Ingest role ARN added. Staging account credentials in vault under `marketplace/staging/3820001020`.
Aisha (partnerships): Great. Next step owners and deadlines:
- Tom: publisher enrollment + publisher IDs (AWS/GCP) by Tue
- Sam: manifest + staging + presigned links (done) and Azure SAS flow by Wed
- Liam: EULA/DPA + export attestation by Mon/Tue
- Nadia: metering conversion + draft price bands + finance signoff request by Wed
- Priya: mapping plan -> internal SKU + onboarding params by Wed
If blockers surface ping here. Tag @aisha for escalations.
Priya (product): One more ask: telemetry labels from marketplace (offer_id, plan_id) need to be mapped into our logs so cost analytics works. @Tom can we inject metadata at ingest?
Tom (cloud-ops): Yes we can. We'll add `X-Marketplace-Offer` and `X-Marketplace-Plan` headers to the ingest pipeline and persist them in request logs.
Aisha (partnerships): Thanks team. I'll assemble a short checklist doc and link it here once Tom/Liam/Nadia confirm their bits. :partyparrot:
